q: google.com type karne ke baad sabse pehle kaun sa network step hota hai (URL parse ke baad)?
explain: IP ke bina connection ban hi nahi sakta, isliye pehle DNS se google.com ka IP nikala jaata hai (cache -> resolver -> root -> TLD -> authoritative).

q: Google door hai (LAN ke bahar). To host ARP se kiska MAC address dhoondhta hai?
options: Kisi ka nahi, ARP ki zaroorat nahi
explain: Destination LAN ke bahar ho to host apne default gateway ka MAC ARP karta hai, Google ka nahi, kyunki pehla frame router ko jaana hai.

q: Packet jab ek router se dusre router jaata hai, to kya same rehta hai?
options: Source aur destination IP address (NAT chhod ke)
explain: Har hop par MAC address badalta hai aur TTL 1 kam hota hai, par source/destination IP end-to-end same rehta hai (jab tak NAT use na ho).

q: HTTPS connection mein TLS handshake kis step ke baad hota hai?
explain: TLS TCP ke upar chalta hai, isliye pehle TCP 3-way handshake connection banata hai, phir TLS handshake use encrypt karta hai.

q: Dusri baar google.com khulne par page zyada tez kyun load hota hai?
options: Internet speed apne aap badh jaati hai
DNS answer, connection reuse aur cached CSS/JS/images ki wajah se
Google har baar naya server deta hai
Browser HTTP ki jagah FTP use karta hai
explain: DNS jawab TTL tak cache rehta hai, TCP/TLS connection reuse ho jaata hai, aur CSS/JS/images browser cache se aa jaate hain, isliye dobara handshake aur download nahi karna padta.
